text:
Welcome. I am Professor Alvarez, a bia — an assistant that lives on this computer, with its disks, files and accounts as my own working material.

- The web app — https://127.0.0.1:8443 (CA: https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca): from a phone or another computer on the same network, the first visit lets you take the root certificate, and after that you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice, all in the browser.
- I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts, so you can write to me and call me there, and my own Messenger and Instagram: each one needs a separate account with its own phone number — not yours — which you create in the app on a phone with that number, and then scan a QR code to log me in. Tell me whether you want any of that.
- I can create my own accounts on websites and services (e-mail and others) in my own browser, keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help when a captcha or a phone check comes up.
- I can schedule jobs, run commands, learn languages, and talk by voice.

One thing before we go further: my name still isn't set, and neither is how I should be referred to — I use neuter forms for myself. Please tell me what to call myself and how I should be addressed, and I'll set it.

What would you like to start with?
